The deadman watchdog is off. A payload that hangs will hang the board
with it, and getting out of that means a reset or the mains.
  Type deadman <seconds> to arm it and deadman off to disarm it. The
  seconds are decimal and whole.

  deadman that fires SOONER than it promised is a trap and one that

# Raspberry Pi 4 / BCM2711 - bare-metal boot via U-Boot
# PureMetal Forge, 2026-08-24

arm_64bit=1

# ANVIL IS THE BOOT IMAGE, 2026-08-26.
#
# U-Boot is STILL ON THIS STICK as kernel8.img and is untouched. To go
# back to it, change the kernel= line below to kernel8.img and drop
# the kernel_address line. That is the whole recovery: one text edit on
# this file, not a re-image.
#
# kernel_address is NOT optional. Anvil is built to run at 0x200000 and
# its BSS - which includes a 550 KB XHCI arena - runs well past the end
# of the image. Loaded at the 64-bit default of 0x80000 that BSS would
# reach down through 0x100000, which is where Anvil puts its own stack.
# Loading it where it was linked keeps the memory map that is actually
# tested.
kernel=kernel8.img
kernel_address=0x200000

# THE CONSOLE ON GPIO14/15 (header pins 8 and 10).
#
# disable-bt is NOT optional. With Bluetooth enabled the Pi 4 gives those
# header pins to the MINI-UART and routes the PL011 to the Bluetooth
# module - so a program writing to the PL011 is talking to a device that
# works perfectly and is not attached to the wire. That cost an evening:
# reads came back healthy, writes vanished, nothing faulted.
#
# disable-bt puts the PL011 back on the header, where init_uart_clock
# then genuinely matters. The mini-UART derives its baud from the VPU
# core clock, which the firmware scales; a PL011 with a pinned reference
# does not move.
dtoverlay=disable-bt
enable_uart=1
init_uart_clock=48000000

# OVERSCAN OFF, 2026-08-26.
#
# Without this the firmware trims 48 px from every edge of a CEA/TV HDMI
# mode, so a 1920x1080 panel comes up as 1824x984. That is not our doing:
# display.pi4 already sends SET_OVERSCAN 0,0,0,0 in the same nine-tag
# transaction U-Boot uses, and the firmware ignores it. The reduction is
# baked into the boot mode before any program asks.
#
# It went unnoticed because DisplayInit asks GET_PHYSICAL_W_H first and
# requests whatever that answers, so we were faithfully asking for the
# already-shrunken size and getting exactly what we asked for.
disable_overscan=1
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-dsi-waveshare-panel-v2,10_1_inch_a
uart_2ndstage=1
dtdebug=on


# Anvil EL3 entry: the firmware loads our reviewed 512-byte stub at zero.
# Remove this one setting to return to the firmware default EL2 handoff.
[pi4]
armstub=armstub8.bin
